question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Inherent
solution:
The correct answer is "**inborn**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the implication of the highlighted word:
 
• **Inherent**__:** existing in something as a permanent**, essential, or characteristic attribute.
 __
 
• Example: *Any form of mountaineering has its **inherent **dangers.*
 
 
 
• Let us understand the implication of the correct word:
 
• **Inborn**__:** existing from birth,** inherited or permanent.
 __
 
• Example:* He has **inborn **qualities of a leader.*
 
 
 
• It is apparent from the above explanation that **"inborn**" is an** appropriate synonym** for "**inherent**".
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is:* **Inborn***
